# Wash Cycle

> T & L Equipment Sales Co., Inc. is a Charlotte-based commercial laundry equipment supplier specializing in Speed Queen and Continental Girbau solutions for diverse industries.

Wash Cycle serves as the digital hub for T & L Equipment Sales, a Southeast-based commercial laundry equipment distributor offering products, parts, service, and industry-specific solutions. The site provides resources for laundromat ownership, equipment selection, and tailored solutions across hospitality, healthcare, education, and other sectors.

## Industry Solutions

- [Self Serve Laundromats](https://www.washcycle.com/industries/self-serve-laundromat): Solutions for self-serve laundromat startups and operations
- [Hospitality Facilities](https://www.washcycle.com/industries/hospitality): Laundry equipment and design solutions for hotels and hospitality
- [Health Care Facilities](https://www.washcycle.com/industries/health-care-facilities): Commercial laundry equipment for hospitals and healthcare facilities
- [Schools and Education](https://www.washcycle.com/industries/schools-education): Commercial laundry equipment for schools, universities, and education
- [Apartment Facilities](https://www.washcycle.com/industries/apartment-laundry-rooms): Coin and card payment laundry solutions for apartment facilities
- [Restaurant & Food Service](https://www.washcycle.com/industries/restaurants-food-service): Commercial laundry equipment solutions for restaurants and food service
- [Laundry Equipment For Fire Departments](https://www.washcycle.com/industries/fire-departments): NFPA 1851 compliant turnout gear cleaning and drying solutions
- [Athletic & Fitness Facilities](https://www.washcycle.com/industries/athletic-departments-fitness-facilities): Commercial laundry solutions for athletic and fitness facilities
- [Hair Salon & Spa Facilities](https://www.washcycle.com/industries/hair-salon-spa): Laundry equipment and design solutions for hair salons and spas
- [Correctional Facilities](https://www.washcycle.com/industries/correctional-facilities): Industrial laundry solutions for correctional facilities
